panels.title: Time since last successful upgrade
panels.description: Time since unattended-upgrade last exited successfully. It succeeds nightly even with nothing to install, so this should never exceed ~24h. Investigate with /var/log/unattended-upgrades/ on the host.

panels.title: Security updates pending
panels.description: Installed packages with a pending security upgrade. Briefly non-zero between a security release and the next nightly run is normal; persistently non-zero means upgrades are not being applied.

panels.title: Reboot pending
panels.description: How long /var/run/reboot-required has existed. The automatic reboot is at 02:00, so anything over ~12h means it did not happen.

panels.title: Broken packages
panels.description: Packages left half-installed by an interrupted dpkg run, or with unmet dependencies. Needs manual repair, e.g. `sudo dpkg --configure -a`.

panels.title: datalab version
panels.description: Recorded by ansible-terraform at the end of each successful `make deploy`.

panels.title: Playbook version
panels.description: datalab-ansible-terraform version used for the last deploy.

panels.title: Time since last deploy
panels.description: Recorded by ansible-terraform at the end of each successful `make deploy`.
